database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. The last recorded Production Vercel environment value was VITE_ROOM_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=30000 (checked 2026-11-05 18:49 UTC); at that setting the estimate is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. The source fallback when the variable is absent is 5,000 ms, which would yield 1,036,800 polls/month for two continuously open tabs. This fallback is not evidence of the deployed interval. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Prisma Console read-only inspection around 2026-11-06 12:16 UTC confirmed the workspace is Free at $0.00 with 51,121/200,000 operations (25.6%), leaving 148,879 for the billing period. The Production database showed 11,714 operations and Preview 25,314; the two Abominations databases account for 37,028 operations, while the allowance is workspace-wide and includes unrelated projects. The listed projects sum to 51,121. Workspace usage showed 0.07/2.00 GiB storage and a rounded 8.5K operations/day. The meter does not attribute operations to individual requests, and synthetic activity may skew the daily average. The Production Backups page around 12:10 UTC showed no backups and states automated daily backups are available on paid plans. A manual dump/restore drill passed once, but no recurring schedule or owner exists. No billing or database setting was changed.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: The direct Prisma Console workspace meter around 2026-11-06 12:16 UTC showed 148,879 operations remaining. Source-based estimates at the last recorded deployed polling interval of 30 seconds are 480 room-poll operations for a two-player two-hour match and 960 for four players; if every remaining operation were used only for polls, this would be at most about 310 two-player or 155 four-player sessions, before setup, actions, reconnects, presence, other workspace projects, or system operations. Two tabs polling continuously every 30 seconds would produce an estimated 172,800 polls per 30-day month. The code fallback is five seconds if the deployment variable is absent; this would produce an estimated 1,036,800 polls/month for two continuously open tabs. Neither estimate is a measured gameplay capacity or normal-use projection.
